user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my sister and I need some unique decoration ideas. Can you suggest some creative DIY decoration projects? Also, recommend a bakery that specializes in custom-designed cakes for special occasions. Additionally, provide some fun party game ideas that can keep the guests entertained. Finally, suggest a DJ or a live band that can create a lively atmosphere at the party.

TaskList.description: Research and compile unique DIY decoration ideas for a surprise birthday party.
Identify and recommend a bakery that specializes in custom-designed cakes for special occasions.
Gather and suggest fun party game ideas that can entertain the guests.
Find and recommend a DJ or live band suitable for creating a lively atmosphere at the party.
